name: Joshua Rotenberg
headline: Paid Search Supervisor
summary: Performance marketing professional with 15+ years managing client campaigns and reporting frameworks in agency and SaaS environments, including hands-on Google Ads management and current GA4-driven analysis. Built ROI/CAC/LTV reporting frameworks and led QBRs translating campaign performance into clear recommendations for clients and leadership. Comfortable being the primary point of contact for client-facing paid media questions, digging into performance data to diagnose issues, and communicating findings clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.

bullets: Managed integrated digital marketing strategies across inbound, paid media, and content as strategic lead, coordinating execution across internal departments.
Built rigorous campaign performance reporting frameworks tracking ROI, CAC, LTV, and conversion KPIs, delivering optimization recommendations and QBRs.
Ran Google keyword research and search-term analysis to shape campaign targeting and content direction.
Managed multi-stakeholder accounts across marketing and technology channels, translating performance data into strategic recommendations.

experience.title: Founder & Strategic / Marketing Operations Lead
bullets: Optimized a client's Google Ads account, cutting spam and low-quality leads and improving click-through quality, then diagnosed on-site CRO as the remaining conversion bottleneck.
Build performance dashboards tracking lead generation, funnel progression, campaign ROI, and pipeline velocity, delivering insights to business owners on a regular cadence.
Track acquisition and retention across multiple accounts using GA4 and CRM analytics, delivering reporting that drives experimentation and growth.
Conduct competitor research and keyword-gap analyses, translating findings into campaign and content recommendations.

experience.title: Account Executive / Sales Operations
bullets: Analyzed campaign performance data at a performance marketing agency, translating results into optimization recommendations across paid media and creative.
Built and refined internal processes that improved reporting accuracy and reduced handoff errors.

bullets: Managed a high-value account portfolio across diverse verticals, contributing to a 30% increase in website traffic and 25% improvement in conversion rates across the e-commerce segment.
Served as primary strategic contact for client accounts, delivering launches on time and accelerating time-to-value.
Onboarded and launched 25+ clients per month, holding 120% of sales targets and 110% of implementation targets.

bullets: Analyzed partner utilization and performance metrics to identify adoption gaps and recommend interventions that reduced churn.
Onboarded and managed 15-20 reseller partners (deal sizes ~$10K-$45K), retaining all but one (roughly 94% retention) during tenure.

experience.title: Account Executive
bullets: Ranked top three in sales on a team of 8 to 15 reps for effectively the full tenure, holding that ranking while quota roughly doubled over the period.
